# /crav1-ideas-to-spec

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From a pile of ideas to a spec](../../from-ideas.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-ideas-to-spec/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Turn a free-form pile of ideas (and any technical hunches in the same text) into a spec, diagrams, ADRs, and a chosen export format.

Idea pile + technical hunches → thin `docs/system/` when missing, including `glossary.md`, then spec, diagrams, ADRs, chosen export, then one index row. An existing landscape is left in place. A missing `glossary.md` is filled. New glossary rows are appended. Existing rows are not rewritten. A meaning the source does not state is `to be researched`. That same pass adds what is new to the short description, the diagram, and how the parts connect. It does not rewrite what is already there. On Azure Repos, offers once to write `work-item.md`.

## Runs when

A pile of ideas and hunches. Called by the user.

This is one of the six starter options. Asking for startup options names it and does not run it.

## Reads

In short: One unstructured pile and the repo.

Reads one unstructured pile and the repo.

## Writes

In short: `spec.md`, `diagrams.md`, slice ADRs, the chosen `export/`, optional `notes.md`, the same landscape result as spark, `Synced at`, `work-item.md` on an Azure Repos opt-in, and `Used by` on a quoted note.

Writes `spec.md`, `diagrams.md`, slice ADRs, the chosen `export/`, optional `notes.md`, the same landscape or index-and-glossary result as spark, and `work-item.md` on an Azure Repos opt-in. Where it reads a whole repo, sets that repo's `Synced at` cell and touches only those repos. Where it reads only one slice, leaves that column alone and writes or updates `Synced at: <repo> <branch>@<short sha>, <date>` on that slice's `spec.md`.

## Does not

Leaves application code and the rest of an existing landscape alone.

Limits and exceptions: two or more v0 slices or repos writes nothing and points at [`/crav1-intake-to-specs`](crav1-intake-to-specs.md). A quoted note in `docs/notes/` gets `Used by <slug>`. `Absorbed by <slug>` only after the user says yes, when this spec takes the whole note.
